title: Antler Expandable Carry-on Luggage $150 Delivered @ Antler
body:
Deal: Antler Expandable Carry-on Luggage $150 Delivered @ Antler

[prkr] I have had Antler luggage for 3 years. I lived in hotels for two, on multiple flights per week, and did a lot of walking. From bus transfers to Ubers and taxis, and many many hotels, the luggage has held up incredibly. Completely flawless other than scuff marks (which would probably polish off if I tried). Never been more impressed by luggage as even my previous cases from other brands haven’t held up the same.
[sydonk] Which Antler model did you get out of interest?
[prkr] Clifton 80cm and Clifton 56cm. The 56cm has seen far more use but both seem to have held up the same. Even the wheels are still in great nick.
[letmethefuqin] Disagree with this, I own 3 of them and literally use them daily. soft case and hard case
The handles are absolute dog shit and can’t be repaired.
If you insist on going antler go hard see over soft case, the hard cases don’t have as much volume inside.
Antle sold to stand bags a few years ago so the quality matches
[iluvbargainz] Agreed. Had our Antler suitcases for 7 years and still going strong. Bought 2 smaller ones just this year and just as good as the others we have.
[bargaino] Inflated RRP and horrid AI-generated website does not a bargain make.
[cmyk] If the primary use case is for carry-on, why would you get this heavy 3.14kg bag?? That's nearly half of the 7kg allowed
[Kick Cashback] Fair point. At 3.14kg it definitely isn't the best choice if you're trying to maximise every kilo of a strict 7kg carry-on allowance.
I think the trade-off here is durability versus weight. For someone regularly flying on a 7kg limit and packing heavily, a lighter cabin bag would probably make more sense.
[costas60] Lets see what Jetstar will do after Feb will they check?
[Codybyrne] @freedomofspeech: because it is basically the only method of travel between many destinations in Australia?
[costas60] anyone used this one at 2.7kg
https://our.raa.com.au/shop/luggage-travel-and-accessories/h…
or this can get black at $199
https://www.samsonite.com.au/samsonite/oc2lite/carry-on-55cm…
[Southern Swindler] Have used the AT lite max for the last 5 years - still going strong and stood up to lots of abuse. Good balance of being light and hard case has protected many purchases.
[oatmatcha] I was going to comment to say Antler is okay for the price, but I'd never go back after getting Samsonites. One of them is the Oc2lite you linked (mine is larger though) and the build quality is just better. The outside looks and feels nicer, the lining is better quality, but most importantly, the wheels are so much smoother. Makes a big difference on rough or uneven surfaces.
[eecan] The wheels on my Samsonite 73H luggage are definitely better than my previous Antler but some seams failed on my Samsonite less than 3 years after I bought it and Samsonite is refusing to honour the 10 year warranty so that has changed my opinion on them.
